title: film6-trace/1 — the trace that stage6 replays
description: A recorded business day. Every event is one line the witness printed (`§FILM_EVT actor=… kind=… t=…`, see FILM_EVT.md); nothing is authored by the stage. header.status must be "REAL" for the published film; "DRAFT" makes stage6 paint a DRAFT watermark and film6_guard.js REFUSE it (exit 4).

sample_day_label.description: the clock is a SCHEDULE for a sample day, labelled on screen; it is not a measurement

to_min.description: minutes since 00:00 of the sample day; > 1440 = the next morning

initial_online.description: actor id -> boolean, state before the first event

src.description: § / witness the caption is read from

sources.description: witness runs this trace was built from: name, command, log path, sha256

schedule.description: file that maps each witness event to its sample-day time (a schedule, labelled as such)

actors.description: ids fixed by the stage layout: till, phone1, phone2, verifier, clerk, stock, relay

t_min.description: sample-day clock, minutes since 00:00 (from the schedule file). Non-decreasing WITHIN a beat; a new beat (chapter) may go back in time: the chapters replay their own part of the same sample day, and the timeline keeps the ticks of the earlier chapters

queue.description: local: delta to the actor's waiting-to-send count

slip.description: local on a phone: what the phone shows about the slip

todo.description: local on a phone: the ToDo of §40.2

wit.description: the witness id + the §FILM_EVT line number in its log; "DRAFT" only in a DRAFT trace
